title: Async SAX reader and DOM input composition

acceptance.description: Add frozen real async SAX Parse/ParseWithDiagnostics, reader ReadAsync/IAsyncDisposable, and DOM Load/LoadWithDiagnostics through bounded transport/core pump; synchronous callbacks, call+operation tokens, true async external resolution and fault cleanup.

Prove actually awaited short reads and async-only resolver streams, sync/async token/DOM/event equality, recovery/diagnostics, EOF/current view lifetime, cancellation/reentrancy/error identity and leave-open exactly-once async cleanup without Task.Run bridges.

Demonstrate only verified dependencies; compiled APIs, real buffered primitive and async process-wide allocation/retained scratch evidence; preserve earlier sync input and validate known tested revision.

handoff.summary: Focused child of M3-async; parent retains original integrated acceptance.
requests: Coordinator grants existing XmlReader.cs only sync Read idle mode selection insertion after completed guard; future async partial uses verified M3-resource-mode setter. Preserve frozen sync behavior and prior source checks.
